title: How to Build a Newsletter from Zero to 10K Subscribers
excerpt: A practical step-by-step guide to growing a newsletter to 10,000 subscribers using lead magnets, cross-promotion, growth loops, and platform strategy on ConvertKit and Beehiiv.
content:
## Choosing Your Platform: ConvertKit vs. Beehiiv

The platform you start on shapes your growth trajectory. ConvertKit (now Kit) is the gold standard for creators with visual automations, subscriber tagging, and landing page builder. Pricing: free up to 1,000 subscribers, then $29/month for up to 3,000. Beehiiv includes a native recommendation network called Boosts, a built-in ad marketplace, and referral programs. Free up to 2,500 subscribers, then $42/month. For a solopreneur starting from zero, Beehiiv's organic distribution can deliver 200-500 subscribers per month with zero additional effort.

## Building Your Lead Magnet Engine

A compelling lead magnet converts 5-15% of visitors into subscribers, compared to 0.5-2% for generic prompts. Best formats: Notion templates, swipe files, checklists, mini-courses. Identify the top question your audience asks repeatedly, then package the answer as a downloadable resource. Place the opt-in form above the fold.

## Cross-Promotion and Growth Loops

Partner with newsletters in adjacent niches (1,000-20,000 subscribers). A well-crafted cross-promotion sends 50-200 subscribers your way. Aim for one per week, rotating through 3-5 regular partners. Growth loops: Beehiiv's referral program rewards subscribers for sharing. Even a viral coefficient of 0.3 means 30% of growth comes for free.

## Content Strategy and Monetization

Weekly is the sweet spot for growth. Each issue: a hot take in the first paragraph, 2-3 actionable points, and a single CTA. Launch a sponsorship tier at 2,000 subscribers — rates range from $0.02-$0.10 per subscriber per send. At 10K, those rates double, generating $2,000-$6,000 per month from 4-6 recurring sponsors.

## Growth Loops in Practice

To build an effective growth loop, start with a referral incentive that aligns with your audience's values. For a B2B newsletter, offer a premium template or a 30-minute strategy call for every 5 referrals. Use Beehiiv's built-in referral system or set up a manual tracking spreadsheet. The key is making the referral ask natural — include it at the end of your best-performing emails rather than every edition. Track referral sources to identify your super-spreaders and nurture those relationships with exclusive content or direct access. A well-designed growth loop can convert 15-30% of your existing subscribers into active promoters, giving your newsletter exponential reach without proportional effort.

## Monetization Strategy Beyond Sponsorships

At 5,000 subscribers, diversify beyond sponsorships. Launch a paid tier with bonus content — deep dives, templates, or a monthly Q&A call. Price it at $10-$20/month and expect 2-5% conversion from your free list. At 10K subscribers, a paid tier at $15/month with 3% conversion generates $4,500/month. Combine with affiliate income from tools you genuinely use (ConvertKit, Beehiiv, SparkLoop) and digital products like Notion templates or mini-courses. The goal is to reach $10K/month from the newsletter alone, making it a standalone business rather than just a marketing channel.
